verses.1: Therefore, when you suffer through the pain of Christ’s suffering, you also must take up that same spirit. For those who suffer through the pain of Christ’s suffering, they are freed from sin.
verses.2: To live for a long time, according to God’s will, rather than following human desires.
verses.3: For the time that has passed since the nations decided to act together is sufficient. This time includes times of sorrow, desire, drunkenness, wars, feasts, and worship of idols.
verses.4: In whom they are hospitable to you, not forcing you into that state of weakness and suffering.
verses.5: Those who will give an account to those who deserve it, both during their lifetime and after death.
verses.6: For this very purpose, the dead were also evangelized, so that they might be judged according to human flesh, but live according to God’s spirit.
verses.7: But the end will surely come. So, be careful and pray diligently.
verses.8: Before all else, they should have a deep love for themselves, because love covers many sins.
verses.9: To be hospitable to each other without any hostility.
verses.10: Each one, as he received a gift from God, served it in his own way, acting as a good steward of the gifts bestowed upon him by God.
verses.11: If anyone speaks words that are like God’s words; if anyone serves with devotion, as God commands. This is so that God can be glorified among all people through Jesus Christ. He is the one who brings glory and power to God for all ages to come. Amen.
verses.12: Beloved ones, do not be subjected to the temptation of being treated as strangers by those who are among you.
verses.13: But instead, rejoice in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may also rejoice with joyousness when His glory is revealed.
verses.14: If you are blessed in the name of Christ, then be blessed indeed, for the spirit of glory and of God is resting upon you.
verses.15: For none of you should suffer as murderers, thieves, oppressors, or as those who commit other kinds of evil deeds.
verses.16: But if you are a Christian, do not be arrogant. Instead, praise the God in this name.
verses.17: Because the time for judgment to begin from the house of God has already arrived. But if it starts with us first, then what will be the outcome for those who are condemned by the gospel of God?
verses.18: And if the righteous is only saved, how can the wicked and sinners be saved?
verses.19: So that even those who suffer in accordance with God’s will, the faithful and righteous ones, may offer their souls in devotion.
